competencies.name: Distributed Systems Design
competencies.seniority_bar: Mid-level: capable of designing scalable, fault‑tolerant services that handle high transaction volumes.
competencies.description: Experience building and operating distributed systems, understanding failure modes, and ensuring reliability.

competencies.name: Idempotency & Data Consistency
competencies.seniority_bar: Mid-level: implements idempotent operations and strong consistency guarantees under failure.
competencies.description: Proficiency with techniques to ensure idempotency and maintain data consistency in payment processing.

competencies.name: API & Service Development
competencies.seniority_bar: Mid-level: designs clear, versioned APIs and internal services with strong contracts.
competencies.description: Skill in designing APIs and services that meet functional and non‑functional requirements.

competencies.name: Production Incident Management
competencies.seniority_bar: Mid-level: leads debugging of production incidents and authors actionable postmortems.
competencies.description: Ability to triage, diagnose, and resolve production issues, and communicate learnings.

competencies.name: Cross‑functional Collaboration
competencies.seniority_bar: Mid-level: works effectively with product, compliance, and other stakeholders on payment flows.
competencies.description: Experience collaborating with non‑engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.

competencies.name: Stakeholder Communication
competencies.seniority_bar: Mid-level: articulates technical tradeoffs clearly to non‑technical audiences.
competencies.description: Skill in explaining complex decisions, risks, and alternatives to product, compliance, or leadership.

competencies.name: Mentorship & Team Growth
competencies.seniority_bar: Mid-level: provides guidance and code reviews to junior engineers, fostering their development.
competencies.description: Willingness to mentor teammates, share knowledge, and contribute to a supportive engineering culture.
